code_assessment: FloodStationFilm.tsx (b4a0ce8f), case 'validation-card', lines 587 to 599. push = fr==='detail' ? ease(raw({start:shot.start_s,end:shot.start_s+1})) : 0. pic=<Cam f={[560,700]} s={lerp(1,1.3,push)} a={[560,700]}><Grounded baseY={1240} on={exterior}>. The card is at At p={[150,400]} s={.8}: Card is 640x380, so x 150 to 662 and y 400 to 704. The figure is drawn at card x 40 (world x 182), font 84 times .8 (about 67 px), baseline about world y 541. The tag is at At p={[200,760]} s={.86}: the 'Initial assessments after training' tag with side right extends right from about world x 185. The disclosure chip is screen-space, outside the camera group, at x 44 and y 132. It is two 32-px lines plus 24 for this wrapped text (DISCLOSURE_MAX 330), so it ends near y 220. PUSH ALONE IS NOT ENOUGH. The Cam maps x to 560+(x-560)*1.3, so at full push the visible world x range is about 129 to 960, not the brief's 145 to 975 (which wrongly centres the range on 560). The card's left edge (150) and the '9' (from 182) would then land at screen x 27 and 69, still visible, and the card top at screen y 310, below the chip. Push alone therefore reproduces neither defect. The extra transform is Grounded, which becomes PlaceSubject for this exterior shot (s7 interior false, framing detail). Under MODERN_FILM.md that subject rides the plate camera on the scene's camera_strategy, which per the builder's handoff zooms about film row 960. A ground zoom of about 1.2 about (540,960), composed inside the 1.3 push, moves the '9' to about screen x -24, so it reads '8.82%'. It lifts the card top to about screen y 166, under the chip (finding 2), and moves the tag's left part off-frame (finding 2's clipping). That is consistent with the report. The fix must therefore bound scale and focus from the screen-space extents of the card, the figure glyph box and the tag after Cam composed with PlaceSubject, keeping the heading clear of the chip's bottom plus a margin, for A's dollyThrough and B's truckAcross separately and across the whole shot window, not only at push end. An acceptable alternative is to move the board's composition, card and tag anchors inside the branch so they fit under the maximum composed scale. B shares the branch and has framing 'detail' at the same shot times, so it very likely carries the same crop; it is unreviewed because the provider judged A.
